svg.text: Effect of temperature on next-token probabilities
Behaves almost like argmax — "forward" wins nearly every time. Diversity near zero.
Balanced — model's learned preferences respected, but with real variety. Baseline for sampling.
Flat — "pizza" now ~1%, nonsense text possible. Creativity up, coherence down.
formula: softmax_with_temperature(logits, T) = softmax( logits / T )
